title: Residential Lease and Tenancy Agreement
parties: Rajesh Sharma (Lessor) and Amit Verma (Lessee)
summary_text: A 11-month residential tenancy agreement for property in Bangalore with monthly rent of INR 45,000, 5% annual escalation, 2 months lock-in period, and INR 2.5 Lakhs refundable security deposit.
full_text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AND TENANCY AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT made on 15th June 2024 between Rajesh Sharma (Lessor) and Amit Verma (Lessee).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 45,000 per month (Deposit INR 2,50,000).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. RENT AND DEPOSIT:
The Lessee shall pay a monthly rent of INR 45,000 payable on or before 5th of each English calendar month, along with an interest-free refundable security deposit of INR 2,50,000.

CLAUSE 2. ESCALATION CLAUSE:
Upon completion of 11 months, if renewed by mutual consent, the monthly rent shall automatically increase by 10% per annum.

CLAUSE 3. UNILATERAL TERMINATION & FORFEITURE:
Lessor reserves unconditional right to terminate tenancy with 7 days notice without cause and forfeit 50% deposit if premise is vacated before lock-in.

CLAUSE 4. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS:
Lessee shall bear all internal minor repair costs up to INR 2,000 while major structural repairs remain Lessor's responsibility under Transfer of Property Act.

CLAUSE 5. INDEMNIFICATION:
Lessee agrees to unconditionally indemnify and hold Lessor harmless against any structural damages, neighbor disputes, or municipal violations arising during occupancy.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

title: Absolute Sale Deed for Immovable Residential Property
parties: Venkatesh Rao (Vendor) and Suresh Kumar (Purchaser)
summary_text: Conveyance of freehold 3BHK residential apartment in Hyderabad for INR 85,00,000 with clear marketable title, indemnity against past encumbrances, and peaceful vacant possession under Registration Act 1908.
full_text:
ABSOLUTE SALE DEED FOR IMMOVABLE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY

THIS AGREEMENT made on 10th January 2024 between Venkatesh Rao (Vendor) and Suresh Kumar (Purchaser).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 85,00,000.

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. CONSIDERATION AND CONVEYANCE:
The Vendor acknowledges receipt of the full sale consideration of INR 85,00,000 via RTGS and transfers absolute freehold ownership to Purchaser.

CLAUSE 2. FREE FROM ENCUMBRANCE:
The Vendor covenants that the Schedule Property is free from all mortgages, liens, lis pendens, attachment, prior agreements, or statutory tax arrears.

CLAUSE 3. INDEMNITY AGAINST DEFECTIVE TITLE:
The Vendor hereby covenants to keep the Purchaser fully indemnified against any loss, claim, or defect in title discovered within statutory limitation period.

CLAUSE 4. POSSESSION AND TAXES:
Vendor has handed over peaceful vacant physical possession along with original title documents, mother deeds, and municipal tax receipts.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

full_text:
AGREEMENT FOR SALE WITH BUILDER-BUYER CONSTRUCTION LINKED PLAN

THIS AGREEMENT made on 20th August 2023 between Shree Balaji Developers (Promoter) and Priya Nair (Allottee).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 1,20,00,000.

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. PAYMENT SCHEDULE & DELAY PENALTY:
Allottee must pay installments per construction milestones. Any delay in payment attracts 18% per annum compound penal interest.

CLAUSE 2. POSSESSION TIMELINE:
Promoter endeavors to deliver possession within 36 months, with an unconditional 12-month grace period and force majeure defense.

CLAUSE 3. ASYMMETRIC COMPENSATION:
In case of promoter delay beyond grace period, compensation is capped strictly at INR 5 per sq ft per month, waiving all other statutory damages under RERA.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

AUTO LOAN HYPOTHECATION & VEHICLE SECURITY AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT made on 18th November 2023 between HDFC Bank Ltd (Lender) and Manoj Pillai (Borrower).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

Borrower creates exclusive first hypothecation charge over Tata Harrier SUV in favor of Bank, endorsed on RTO RC book under Motor Vehicles Act.

Upon default in payment of two consecutive EMIs, Bank shall have unfettered right to repossess the vehicle without court intervention or prior notice.

CLAUSE 3. PREPAYMENT PENALTY:
Prepayment or foreclosure within first 12 months is subject to 5% foreclosure fee plus applicable GST on outstanding principal balance.

CLAUSE 4. DEFAULT INTEREST & CHEQUE BOUNCE:
Delayed EMI attracts overdue penal interest of 24% per annum compounded monthly plus INR 750 bounce charges per dishonored NACH mandate.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

full_text:
TERM LOAN AND MORTGAGE FACILITY AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT made on 14th March 2024 between State Bank of India (Lender) and Raghavendra Enterprises (Borrower).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 50,00,000 (Floating Rate: Repo + 3.25%).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. SANCTION AND DISBURSEMENT:
Bank sanctions term loan of INR 50,00,000 repayable in 60 equated monthly installments with interest reset on quarterly basis linked to RBI Repo Rate.

CLAUSE 2. CROSS-DEFAULT AND ACCELERATION:
Any default by Borrower or its directors in any other credit facility across any financial institution triggers instant acceleration and total recall of this loan.

CLAUSE 3. SARFAESI ENFORCEMENT & ASSET ATTACHMENT:
Upon classification of account as Non-Performing Asset (NPA), Bank is entitled to enforce security under Section 13(2) of SARFAESI Act 2002 without court decree.

CLAUSE 4. MATERIAL ADVERSE CHANGE (MAC):
Bank reserves right to demand immediate full repayment if in Bank's sole judgment any material adverse change occurs in Borrower's financial health.

CLAUSE 5. PERSONAL GUARANTEE OF DIRECTORS:
Managing Director executes unconditional, irrevocable, joint and several continuing personal guarantee covering all dues and enforcement expenses.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

GOLD JEWELLERY PLEDGE AND LOAN AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT made on 19th April 2024 between Muthoot Finance Ltd (Lender) and K. Narayana Swamy (Borrower).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 3,20,000 (Gross Wt: 85g, Net Wt: 72g 22-Karat).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. PLEDGE OF ORNAMENTS & PURITY APPRAISAL:
Borrower pledges 72 grams net 22-Karat gold ornaments appraised and sealed in tamper-proof pouch in Borrower's presence.

CLAUSE 2. MARGIN CALL & MARKET FLUCTUATION:
If market price of gold drops and Loan-to-Value (LTV) exceeds 75% as per RBI guidelines, Borrower must pay margin money within 14 days of notice.

CLAUSE 3. PUBLIC AUCTION & RECOVERY:
Upon failure to redeem within 12 months or failure to meet margin call, Lender possesses unconditional right to sell gold via public auction to recover principal and penal interest.

CLAUSE 4. SAFE CUSTODY & INDEMNITY:
Lender's liability for pledged gold in case of burglary or fire is strictly limited to standard insurance settlement value, excluding emotional or antique worth.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

GOLD JEWELLERY PLEDGE AND LOAN AGREEMENT (AHMEDABAD JURISDICTION)

THIS LEGAL INSTRUMENT is executed at Ahmedabad on 27/12/2025 between:
PARTY ONE: T. R. Ramachandran, residing in Ahmedabad, and
PARTY TWO: B. K. Shrivastava, residing in Ahmedabad.

VALUATION / CONSIDERATION: INR 3,20,000 (Gross Wt: 85g, Net Wt: 72g 22-Karat) (Ref: Ahmedabad)

TERMS, CONDITIONS AND COVENANTS:

ARTICLE 1. PLEDGE OF ORNAMENTS & PURITY APPRAISAL:
Borrower pledges 72 grams net 22-Karat gold ornaments appraised and sealed in tamper-proof pouch in Borrower's presence. Applicable under laws governing the State of Ahmedabad.

ARTICLE 2. MARGIN CALL & MARKET FLUCTUATION:
If market price of gold drops and Loan-to-Value (LTV) exceeds 75% as per RBI guidelines, Borrower must pay margin money within 14 days of notice. Applicable under laws governing the State of Ahmedabad.

ARTICLE 3. PUBLIC AUCTION & RECOVERY:
Upon failure to redeem within 12 months or failure to meet margin call, Lender possesses unconditional right to sell gold via public auction to recover principal and penal interest. Applicable under laws governing the State of Ahmedabad.

ARTICLE 4. SAFE CUSTODY & INDEMNITY:
Lender's liability for pledged gold in case of burglary or fire is strictly limited to standard insurance settlement value, excluding emotional or antique worth. Applicable under laws governing the State of Ahmedabad.

SIGNED, SEALED AND DELIVERED by the parties at Ahmedabad in the presence of witnesses.

title: Instant Bullet Repayment Gold Overdraft Agreement
parties: Manappuram Finance Ltd (Lender) and G. Sridhar (Borrower)
summary_text: High-interest 6-month bullet repayment gold loan with steep 27% stepping interest rate on default, 7-day emergency notice for auction, and unilateral gold forfeiture terms.
full_text:
INSTANT BULLET REPAYMENT GOLD OVERDRAFT AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT made on 11th January 2024 between Manappuram Finance Ltd (Lender) and G. Sridhar (Borrower).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 4,50,000 at 19% p.a. (Penal 27%).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. BULLET PAYMENT & STEPPING INTEREST:
Entire principal and interest must be paid at end of 6 months. Failure to service interest monthly steps up interest rate to 27% p.a. retrospectively.

CLAUSE 2. EXPEDITED 7-DAY AUCTION NOTICE:
Lender may issue 7-day SMS notice to registered mobile number prior to auctioning gold at local district auction center.

CLAUSE 3. SURPLUS & DEFICIT ADJUSTMENT:
Auction proceeds shall be appropriated first towards legal/auction expenses, then penal interest, then principal. Borrower remains liable for any deficit.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.
